name: Copper Country Cubing 2019

venue.name: Michigan Tech Memorial Union Building Ballroom
venue.address: Michigan Tech Memorial Union Building, Houghton, MI 49931, United States
venue.details: The competition is in the ballroom on the second floor.

information:
This will be the first ever Michigan UP competition!

The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. You can get to the ballroom by following signs to the second floor.

We are excited to announce that in conjunction with this competition, Sydney Weaver and the Cubing Club at Michigan Tech will be hosting a cubing workshop, the Houghton Rubik's Rumble! Check out the [Workshop Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CopperCountryCubing2019#9666-workshop-info) tab to learn about this event.
